newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday May 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday May 5.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
* An Albanian refugee ship with up to 1,500 people on board limped into the southern Italian port of Bari on Sunday, one of two crowded ships racketeers attempted to send across the Adriatic (all).

* More than 100,000 supporters of Italy's main opposition centre-right bloc packed the cathedral square in central Milan at the weekend in an anti-government rally one week before run-offs in key mayoral elections (all).

* In an interview, hard left National Alliance party leader Gianfranco Fini blamed Italian president Oscar Luigi Scalfaro for not being representative of the country's interest anymore but trying to support under any circumstances centre-left majority. Fini defined Scalfaro's stand as "politically intollerable" and said the president's objections to the European Community judgements would damage Italy (Corriere della Sera).

* Textile group Marzotto has called off a merger with industrial holding HPI that would have created one of the biggest textiles and clothing companies in the world. The shock decision to scrap creation of an 8.24 trillion lire group was a blow to the Italian financial establishment, as car maker Fiat and top investment bank Mediobanca were to have held big stakes in the new group after the merger (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
